title: The Moon Door
description: A little boy finds a tiny magical door behind his bookshelf that opens up a portal to walk directly onto the moon.
visual_style: cinematic high-quality 3D animated film, expressive characters, detailed environments, soft cinematic lighting, beautiful colors, depth of field, consistent character design, vertical 9:16 composition

characters.name: Leo
characters.appearance: Round face, big curious hazel eyes, messy brown hair, freckles across his nose
characters.clothing: Striped blue and white pajamas with matching pajama pants, fuzzy red slippers
characters.personality: Inquisitive, imaginative, brave, and easily amazed

scenes.narration: Late at night, Leo noticed a peculiar glow coming from behind his bookshelf.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, 7-year-old boy Leo with messy brown hair and blue striped pajamas peeking behind a wooden bookshelf, a warm golden light glowing from a tiny baseboard crack, soft bedroom lighting, highly detailed.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, slowly pushing in toward the bookshelf

scenes.narration: He moved the heavy books aside to find something impossible.

dialogue.text: Whoa... where did you come from?

scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo in blue striped pajamas pulling aside books, revealing a tiny ornate wooden door glowing with blue starlight embedded in the wall, wide-eyed expression of wonder.
scenes.camera: Close-up on Leo's face reacting to the door

scenes.narration: The tiny brass handle turned effortlessly in his small hand.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo's small hand turning a miniature brass doorknob on the tiny door, sparkling starlight dust spilling out from the slight crack, magical blue glow illuminating his face.
scenes.camera: Macro shot focusing on the hand and the tiny door

scenes.narration: Instead of the hallway wall, he saw craters and distant stars.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, POV looking through the tiny open door, revealing a miniature lunar landscape with gray craters and the deep black cosmos filled with glowing stars.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot looking through the doorway

scenes.narration: With a quick puff of courage, Leo blew a gentle breath into the portal.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo leaning forward in his blue striped pajamas, gently blowing towards the tiny open door, magic particles swirling around him.

scenes.narration: Suddenly, the tiny door expanded, growing as tall as he was.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, the tiny door magically stretching and growing upwards until it is a full-sized doorway in Leo's bedroom wall, glowing with silver lunar light.
scenes.camera: Wide shot of the bedroom as the door expands

scenes.narration: The bedroom floor vanished, replaced by powdery white moondust.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo stepping forward through the glowing doorway, his red slippers touching down onto the gray, powdery surface of the moon, planet Earth visible in the dark sky behind him.
scenes.camera: Low angle tracking shot following his feet

scenes.narration: He took a leap and floated higher than he ever dreamed.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo floating gracefully in low gravity above the lunar surface, arms outstretched in joy, big smile, earth glowing bright blue in the background.
scenes.camera: Wide dynamic tracking shot following his float

scenes.narration: He bounced across craters like a happy astronaut.

dialogue.text: Look how high I can jump!

scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo bouncing playfully over a moon crater in his blue pajamas and red slippers, starlight reflecting in his eyes, joyful expression.
scenes.camera: Medium action shot tracking the bounce
sound_effects: Boing sound effect mixed with space echo

scenes.narration: He spun around and painted constellations with a glowing space rock.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo holding a glowing lunar rock, drawing sparkling lines of light in the air of space, bright colorful nebula clouds swirling around him.
scenes.camera: Close-up on Leo spinning with the glowing rock

scenes.narration: Soon, a familiar yawn reminded him that bedtime was still bedtime, even on the moon.

dialogue.text: Time to head back, I guess.

scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo rubbing his sleepy eyes with one hand, standing on the moon surface next to the open glowing doorway that leads back to his cozy bedroom.

scenes.narration: He stepped back through, leaving the universe tucked safely in his wall.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo stepping backward through the doorway into his dim bedroom, the door shrinking back down to a tiny size as it clicks shut.
scenes.camera: Medium wide shot inside the bedroom

scenes.narration: Climbing into his bed, Leo drifted off to sleep, dreaming of his next galactic adventure.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, Leo fast asleep in his cozy bed under blue blankets, a tiny smile on his face, moonlight streaming softly through his bedroom window.
scenes.camera: Close-up peaceful shot of Leo sleeping
